question: MTP speculative decoding acceptance rate benchmark Qwen3 code generation

sources.title: ecohash-benchmarks/llm/speculative-decoding-qwen3.8-27b.md at main ...
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B with MTP speculative decoding, on one RTX PRO 6000 Qwen3.8-27B ships a multi-token-prediction (MTP) draft head inside the checkpoint. Turning it on in vLLM is one flag. On a single RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition it took per-token latency from 22 ms to 13 ms and doubled the concurrency the card sustains inside the same latency budget.

sources.title: Eval bug: draft-model speculative decoding ~2.2-2.4× slower on Qwen3.5 ...
sources.snippet: With classic draft-model speculation, the hybrid Qwen3.5 target becomes much slower than plain decoding, while a same-size non-hybrid target (Qwen3) with the same draft acceptance rate only loses 10-18%. This suggests the per-step verification/rollback cost on the Gated DeltaNet path is the issue, not draft quality.
